name: Emeritus of Conflict // Lightning Bolt
oracle_text:
First strike
Whenever you cast your third spell each turn, this creature becomes prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
atomic_translated_text: 先攻\n每当你施放每回合中你的第三个咒语时，此生物成为已备法。（于其已备法期间，你可以施放其上咒语的复制品。施放之后其便撤法。）

other_faces.name: Emeritus of Conflict // Lightning Bolt
other_faces.oracle_text: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.
other_faces.atomic_translated_text: 闪电击对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

rulings.comment: If a prepare spell with one or more targets has no legal targets when it tries to resolve, it won't resolve and none of its effects will happen. Since the spell was cast, the associated permanent will still not be prepared.
rulings.translation: 如果具有一个或数个目标的备法咒语在试图结算时没有合法目标，则它不会结算，且其所有效应都不会生效。由于该咒语已被施放，其关联的永久物仍不会是已备法。

rulings.comment: Preparation cards can only be cast with their base characteristics.
rulings.translation: 备法牌只能以其基础特征施放。

rulings.comment: If a prepared creature stops being a creature, it will still be prepared, and the copy of its prepare spell will remain in exile. That permanent's controller will still be able to cast it. The same is true if a prepared creature becomes a copy of something else, even if it's then a permanent without a prepare spell.
rulings.translation: 如果已备法的生物不再是生物，它仍将处于已备法状态，且其备法咒语的复制品仍会留在放逐区。该永久物的操控者仍能施放它。如果已备法的生物成为其他东西的复制品，即使它随后是不具有备法咒语的永久物，情况也是一样。

rulings.comment: A creature with a prepare spell can't become prepared more than once at the same time. For example, Emeritus of Ideation is on the battlefield and is prepared. When it attacks, its last ability triggers. When that ability resolves, its controller may still exile eight cards from their graveyard, but doing so won't cause Emeritus of Ideation to become prepared a second time or create a second copy of Ancestral Recall in exile.
rulings.translation: 具有备法咒语的生物不能同时成为已备法超过一次。例如，创念尊贤在战场上且已备法。当它攻击时，其最后一个异能触发。当该异能结算时，其操控者仍可以从其坟墓场放逐八张牌，但这样做并不会使创念尊贤再次成为已备法，也不会在放逐区中派出第二个先人的召还复制品。

rulings.comment: If an effect instructs you to choose a card name, you may choose the alternative prepare spell's name. Consider only the alternative characteristics to determine whether that is an appropriate name to choose.
rulings.translation: 如果有效应让你选择一个牌名，则你可以选择副特征上的备法名称。在判断能否选择该名称时，仅会考虑其副特征。

rulings.comment: While copies of spells in zones other than the stack cease to exist when state-based actions are checked, this does not apply to copies of prepare spells in exile that were created as a creature became prepared.
rulings.translation: 虽然位于堆叠以外区域的咒语复制品会在检查状态动作时消失，但这并不适用于放逐区中因生物已备法而派出的备法咒语复制品。

rulings.comment: Casting a copy of a prepare spell from exile isn't casting it for an alternative cost. Effects that allow you to cast a spell for an alternative cost or without paying its mana cost may allow you to apply those to a copy of a prepare spell cast from exile.
rulings.translation: 从放逐区施放备法咒语的复制品，并不属于你以替代性费用来施放。对于让你能以替代性费用或以「不需支付其法术力费用」的方式来施放咒语的效应而言，这类效应也会对从放逐区施放的备法咒语复制品生效。

rulings.comment: As an effect causes a creature with a prepare spell to become prepared (including effects that state that a creature "enters prepared"), that creature's controller creates a copy of that creature's prepare spell in exile. That copy remains in exile for as long as that permanent is on the battlefield and is prepared. That creature's controller may cast that copy as long as it remains in exile. As they cast it, that creature stops being prepared.
rulings.translation: 于某效应使具备法咒语的生物成为已备法（包括注明生物「进场时已备法」的效应）时，该生物的操控者在放逐区中派出一个该生物备法咒语的复制品。只要该永久物在战场上且为已备法，该复制品便留在放逐区。只要该复制品仍在放逐区，该生物的操控者便可以施放该复制品。于施放它时，该生物不再处于已备法状态。

rulings.comment: Emeritus of Conflict's last ability resolves before the spell that caused it to trigger. It resolves even if that spell is countered or otherwise leaves the stack without resolving.
rulings.translation: 兴战尊贤的最后一个异能会比触发它的咒语先一步结算。就算该咒语被反击，或因故离开堆叠而未能结算，此异能仍会结算。

rulings.comment: Emeritus of Conflict's last ability will count any spells you've cast this turn, which may include Emeritus of Conflict itself. It doesn't matter if the other spells resolved, didn't resolve, were countered, or are still on the stack. If Emeritus of Conflict was the second spell you cast this turn, the next spell you cast this turn is your third spell. If Emeritus of Conflict is your third spell in a turn, it's not on the battlefield for its triggered ability to trigger, and it will not trigger for further spells cast after it that turn.
rulings.translation: 兴战尊贤的异能会计算你本回合施放过的所有咒语，包括乌索斯心能师本身。其他咒语是否结算、未结算、被反击或仍在堆叠上并不重要。如果兴战尊贤是你本回合施放的第二个咒语，则你本回合施放的下一个咒语就是你的第三个咒语。如果兴战尊贤是你某回合中施放的第三个咒语，其触发式异能不会触发，因为它此时还不在战场上，且该回合此后施放的咒语也不会使其异能触发。

rulings.comment: If an effect causes a creature to become unprepared, a prepared creature stops being prepared and the associated copy of its prepare spell in exile ceases to exist. If it wasn't prepared at that time, nothing happens.
rulings.translation: 如果有效应使某个生物成为已撤法，则已备法生物不再是已备法，且其位于放逐区内与之关联的备法咒语复制品消失。如果该生物当时并非已备法，则不发生任何事。

rulings.comment: Being prepared isn't a copiable value. If a permanent becomes a copy of a prepared creature, it won't be prepared. That permanent will have the alternative characteristics, though, and some other effect could cause it to become prepared later.
rulings.translation: 「已备法」此事并非可复制特征值。如果有永久物成为某个已备法生物的复制品，则它不会是已备法。不过，该永久物会具有副特征，且稍后可能由其他效应使其成为已备法。

rulings.comment: If a prepared creature loses all abilities, it won't stop being prepared, and nothing will happen to its alternative characteristics or to the copy of its prepare spell in exile.
rulings.translation: 如果某个已备法的生物失去所有异能，它不会不再处于已备法状态，且其副特征或其位于放逐区之备法咒语的复制品也均不会受任何影响。

rulings.comment: Only the current controller of a prepared creature can cast the copy of its prepare spell in exile. It doesn't matter who owns that creature or who controlled it when it became prepared.
rulings.translation: 只有已备法生物目前的操控者才能施放其位于放逐区中备法咒语的复制品。至于谁拥有该生物，或者在它成为已备法时由谁操控并不重要。

rulings.comment: Since Emeritus of Conflict will stop being prepared as soon as the copy of Lightning Bolt is cast, casting that copy of Lightning Bolt as your third spell in a turn will result in Emeritus of Conflict becoming prepared again when its last ability resolves.
rulings.translation: 由于一旦施放该闪电击的复制品，兴战尊贤便不再是已备法，因此将该闪电击的复制品作为你本回合中施放的第三个咒语，将导致兴战尊贤在其最后一个异能结算时再次成为已备法。

rulings.comment: Creating a copy of a creature's prepare spell in exile ignores copy exceptions applied to that creature that would affect the copiable values of that spell. For example, say a player casts Croaking Counterpart (a sorcery that says "Create a token that's a copy of target non-Frog creature, except it's a 1/1 green Frog.") targeting Goblin Glasswright. The token copy of Goblin Glasswright will enter prepared as a 1/1 green Frog creature, but the copy of Craft with Pride in exile will still be a red sorcery. The copy of Craft with Pride won't be green, a creature, or a Frog, and it won't have power or toughness.
rulings.translation: 在放逐区中派出生物的备法咒语之复制品时，会忽略所有对该生物生效且原本将影响该咒语之可复制特征值的复制例外。例如，假设某牌手施放呱叫反身（叙述为「派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标非蛙生物的复制品，但它是1/1绿色的蛙」的法术）并以制璃鬼怪为目标。制璃鬼怪的衍生物复制品进场时将为已备法，且为1/1绿色的蛙生物，但位于放逐区中的诚意制作复制品仍会是红色的法术。诚意制作的复制品不会是绿色、生物或蛙，也不具力量或防御力。

rulings.comment: A preparation card is a creature card in every zone. For example, while it's in your graveyard, Emeritus of Ideation is a blue creature whose mana value is 5. It can't be the target of Zealous Lorecaster's triggered ability ("When this creature enters, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.").
rulings.translation: 备法牌在每个区域中都是生物牌。举例来说，当创念尊贤在你的坟墓场中时，它是一张法术力值为5的蓝色生物牌。它不能成为狂热召史师之触发式异能（「当此生物进场时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你坟墓场移回你手上」）的目标。
